Gipson, President and Managing Director Dear Sir: Your registered letter of June 4th just received with colored sketch made by Mrs. Emma Edwards Green, who prepared the original design for the Idaho State flag, which was adopted by the State Legislature. You ask us to preserve it carefully and return it to you after it has served our purpose. This, we will surely do, but we trust you will pardon our frankness in writing you concerning same. It is with no thought or desire of criticism of the sketch, but with the sole purpose of being further informed as to what is the correct design. e are obliged to make the following comments so as to know how to execute same correctly. We desire to know if the design is not to be centered. . The sketch shows the centre shield, ribbon, and in fact the entire design at least ten degrees towards the right instead of being centered. Undoubtedly, you will want the design centered. Is that not correct?\<za , We also note that the Elks head is not resting on the centre of the seal, but is very much to the right. Should it not be at the top of the seal, resting on the center and should not its antlers be those of an Elk instead of a deer. y£e | Now, in regard to the Miner. The illustration shows the miner to have hat, shirt, trousers and boots all brown, whereas the description of the State seal as adopted by the State Legislature | on July 3rd, 1890 and March 14th, 1891, reads: "The man, the most | prominent figure of the design, shall have brown hat, blue tie and } shirt, black boots, brown mustache, but omits to give any reference to the color of the trousers. The woman is to have a white robe, brown hair.
